$comment: regions drive the flag shown in the language switcher, and nothing else. A flag is a
country, not a language, so these name the region each translation is actually written
for: es is Latin American Spanish (glossary.json), not Castilian.
Emoji flags were tried first and do not render on Windows, which ships no flag emoji
font, so these codes select an inline SVG from i18n/locale-flag.tsx. A region with no
SVG falls back to the code itself, so adding a language never breaks the switcher.
